Hi, I’m Soham.

I’m a Kolkata-based Software Engineer at LTIMindtree, where I develop and maintain enterprise applications using C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core Web API, and Microsoft Azure.

My work connects modular architecture with the details that make software dependable: well-defined business rules, secure APIs, and comprehensive unit tests. At LTIMindtree, this includes an enterprise lending platform with Azure Durable Functions orchestrations and modular business logic packages.

I work across RESTful API development, CQRS, domain-driven design, JWT authentication, and state management. I also design ViewModel factories that connect PropertyState-driven UI metadata with milestone-based feature access and business validation.

I also build full-stack projects with Angular, Flask, and Node.js, and use GitHub Copilot and Claude to support code generation, analysis, and testing.
